exposure: relationship status (not being in a relationship or marriage)
type of workplace activity (vigorous physical activity)
cohort: The study included 433 women aged 16 to 49 years (mean 32.0 years) who underwent induced abortions from 2022 to 2024 at the Clinic for Ob/Gyn, University Clinical Centre of Serbia in Belgrade.
finding: The most common motives for abortion were already having enough children and financial difficulties for child upbringing, with not having a steady partner and working in a physically demanding job identified as the most important factors associated with voluntary abortion seeking.
